theme: Just a PDF, not a native device template
use_for: Loads as a plain PDF or document instead of a notebook template on the device; buyer expected native templates.
Praise for roomy boxes, lines or note space.

theme: Stickers ready to copy and paste
use_for: Wants stickers or images that can be placed directly without tracing or extra steps.
Praise that the file runs quickly with no lag on the device.
Wants the daily schedule to start earlier or end later.
Wants the product in a language other than English, or without foreign-language text.
Time slots in 24-hour (military) or other format the buyer finds confusing.

theme: Easier way to receive the files
use_for: Wishes the files were simpler to receive or download after buying.

theme: A video showing how it works
use_for: Wants a demo or video tutorial showing how to use the product.

theme: Times or details pre-filled on pages
use_for: Wants hours, dates or other fixed details already printed on pages so they need not be written each time.
